NOTE:  PUBLIC PARTICIPATION INFORMATION
  Agenda reports and other disclosable public records relating to each Open Session agenda item are
  available on the City's website under City Council Meeting agendas at rhe.city and during regular
  business hours in the office of the City Clerk. Meetings are live broadcast on the City's website and a
  recording is available for viewing after each meeting. Meetings are also broadcast on PVP-TV Channel 35
  (Cox) and Channel 39 (Verizon).

  Public Comment is welcome in-person on any item during City Council consideration of the item. Public
  correspondence may also be emailed to the City Clerk at laurenp@rollinghillsestates.gov. Emails
  received before 3:00 p.m. prior to the start of the meeting will be forwarded to the City Council for their
  consideration and included as part of the record. Members of the public may also comment online using
  eComment on the “Meeting Agendas, Minutes & Videos” page of the City’s website
  (www.rhe.city/MeetingAgendas). Once the agenda is published, there will be an “eComment” button next
  to the linked agenda under "Upcoming Events". Follow this link to the City’s SpeakUp page. After you
  register, you may comment on any item on that particular agenda. These comments can be seen by the
  public, will be considered by the Council and become part of the record.

  An opportunity is also provided for the public to comment on non-agenda items concerning City matters. If
  you would like to address the City Council regarding an item on this agenda or make a general public
  comment, please complete a speaker sheet and give to the City Clerk.

  TO APPROVE AS FOLLOWS BY THE FOLLOWING ROLL CALL VOTE:

  1) ACCEPT THE BID FROM HARDY & HARPER INC. IN THE AMOUNT OF

  $612,700; AND 2) DIRECT THE MAYOR, CITY CLERK AND CITY ATTORNEY
  TO EXECUTE A PUBLIC WORKS CONTRACT BETWEEN THE CITY OF
  ROLLING HILLS ESTATES AND HARDY & HARPER INC., ALL TO THE
  SATISFACTION OF THE CITY ATTORNEY.

  AYES:  Schachter, Huff, Schmitz, Stegura,
  ABSENT:  Zerunyan

CITY COUNCIL MINUTES  4
JUNE 27, 2023
 C.  FOUNDERS PARK PROJECT-REQUEST TO REJECT BIDS AND RESOLICIT BIDS

  Recommendation: That the City Council: 1) Reject the bids received on May 25, 2023
  for Founders Park; and, 2) Authorize staff to resolicit bids for the construction of
  Founders Park, with a sealed bid opening date of Thursday, July 27, 2023, all to the
  satisfaction of the City Attorney.

Public Works Director Wahba provided a staff report (as per the agenda material.)

Public Works Director Wahba explained the estimate was reduced by Willdan by simplifying
the project scope, in response to COUNCIL MEMBER SCHACHTER.

Public Works Director Wahba explained that a large part of the estimate is due to the drainage
necessary on the lot, in response to MAYOR HUFF.

MAYOR PRO TEM SCHMITZ expressed concern that the City runs the risk of estimates
coming in even higher if the project goes out to bid again. Discussion ensued about
construction costs, how they can change during the course of a project, and negotiating costs.

City Attorney Davis noted that negotiating after the project begins is not an ideal practice.

COUNCIL MEMBER STEGURA stated that the project could also be done incrementally,
throughout multiple fiscal years if needed.

Public comment was invited in-person in the Council Chambers, via email and via eComment.
No public testimony was received.

  COUNCIL MEMBER STEGURA moved, seconded by COUNCIL MEMBER
  SCHACHTER, TO APPROVE AS FOLLOWS BY THE FOLLOWING ROLL CALL
  VOTE:

  1) REJECT THE BIDS RECEIVED ON MAY 25, 2023 FOR FOUNDERS PARK;
  AND, 2) AUTHORIZE STAFF TO RESOLICIT BIDS FOR THE
  CONSTRUCTION OF FOUNDERS PARK, WITH A SEALED BID OPENING
  DATE OF THURSDAY, JULY 27, 2023, ALL TO THE SATISFACTION OF THE
  CITY ATTORNEY.

  AYES:  Schachter, Huff, Schmitz, Stegura,
  ABSENT:  Zerunyan

community to be wise with their water usage.

Governments (SBCCOG) Board Meeting last week.

COUNCIL MEMBER SEGURA attended the Doors Open Peninsula 2023 event, including the
Malaga Cove Public Officials event.

MAYOR HUFF and City Manager Grammer joined Cal Water, Los Angeles County Fire, and
the City of Rancho Palos Verdes for the commissioning of a new HeloPod on the Peninsula.

MAYOR HUFF attended the Sanitation District meeting last week.

12.  MAYOR AND COUNCIL ITEMS

A.  AUTHORIZATION TO ATTEND AND DESIGNATION OF VOTING DELEGATES AND
  ALTERNATES- THE LEAGUE OF CALIFORNIA CITIES' ANNUAL CONFERENCE
  AND EXPO IN SACRAMENTO, CALIFORNIA - SEPTEMBER 20 - 22, 2023

MAYOR HUFF will serve as the delegate, and COUNCIL MEMBER SCHACHTER as the
alternate. It was the consensus of the City Council to allow any/all Council Members to attend
the conference.

MAYOR PRO TEM SCHMITZ reminded the public that fireworks are illegal on the Peninsula.
City Manager Grammer added that Los Angeles County Sheriff’s Department and Fire
Department would be doing patrols for firework use.
